issues.description: The template PersonService defines a constructor that accepts a PersonRepository (enabling constructor injection), while the solution's PersonService replaces this with a no-argument constructor that sets the repository field to null. This contradicts the intended dependency-injection design shown in the template and the problem description (PersonService is the application layer using PersonRepository). The solution's no-arg constructor will cause personRepository to be null and lead to runtime NullPointerExceptions when service methods call personRepository, and it will confuse students about how the service should be wired.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore constructor-based injection in PersonService in the solution to match the template and intended design. Change the solution's constructor to public PersonService(PersonRepository personRepository) { this.personRepository = personRepository; } so the repository is correctly injected by Spring and service methods can call personRepository safely.
